exams.name: Environmental Health Specialist Examination
exams.notes: Written examination in physical, biological, and environmental sciences relating to practices and principles of environmental health. Board may administer or approve an examination provider. Board may waive if applicant recognized as outstanding in the field.
exams.jurisdiction: state board or board-approved examination provider
exams.quote: The examination required by the Board shall include a written examination in the physical, biological, and environmental sciences that relates to practices and principles of environmental health.

interval_years.quote: A license expires on the date specified on the license, unless it is renewed for a 2–year term as provided in this section.

available.quote: the Board may waive any examination requirement of this title for an applicant who is licensed or registered as an environmental health specialist or its equivalent in another state.

requirements.value: Applicant must pay the application fee, meet qualifications otherwise required by the title, have become licensed/registered in the other state after passing an examination there, and have performed at least 24 months of compensated work as an environmental health specialist in the other state.
requirements.quote: Has performed at least 24 months of compensated work as an environmental health specialist or its equivalent in the other state.

credential_type.quote: "License" means, unless the context requires otherwise, a license issued by the Board to practice as an environmental health specialist.

is_mandatory.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice as an environmental health specialist in this State

title_protection.quote: Unless a person is licensed under this title, the person may not use the title "environmental health specialist" or "licensed environmental health specialist" or the initials "E.H.S." or "L.E.H.S."

scope_protection.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this title, unless a person is licensed under this title, the person may not practice as an environmental health specialist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively obtaining or attempting to obtain a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently or deceptively obtains or attempts to obtain a license for the applicant or license holder or another;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively using a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently or deceptively uses a license;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly violating any provision of the title or rules/regulations adopted under it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly violates any provision of this title, or any rule or regulation adopted under this title;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, misfeasance, malfeasance, incompetence, or misconduct while performing duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commits any gross negligence, misfeasance, malfeasance, incompetence, or misconduct while performing the duties of an environmental health specialist;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or guilty/nolo contendere plea to a felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is convicted of or pleads guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or to a crime involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing professional services while under the influence of alcohol or drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Provides professional services while: (i) Under the influence of alcohol; or (ii) Using any narcotic or controlled dangerous substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplined by a licensing or disciplinary authority of another state or country for an act that would be grounds for discipline here
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is disciplined by a licensing or disciplinary authority of any other state or country or convicted or disciplined by a court of any state or country for an act that would be grounds for disciplinary action under the Board's disciplinary statutes;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing a false report or record while performing duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully makes or files a false report or record while performing the duties of an environmental health specialist;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to file or record any required report, impeding its filing, or inducing another to fail to file
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully fails to file or record any report as required by law, willfully impedes or obstructs the filing or recording of the report, or induces another to fail to file or record the report;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitting a false statement to collect a fee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submits a false statement to collect a fee;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promoting sale of land, devices, appliances, or goods in a manner that exploits a person for the licensee's financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotes the sale of land, devices, appliances, or goods provided for a person in such a manner as to exploit the person for financial gain of the licensed environmental health specialist;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully altering a sample, specimen, or test procedure to cause false results
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully alters a sample, specimen, or any test procedure to cause the results upon analysis to represent a false finding;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any rule or regulation adopted by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violates any rule or regulation adopted by the Board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or promoting misleading, deceiving, or untruthful advertising matter, promotional literature, or testimonial
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Uses or promotes or causes the use of any misleading, deceiving, or untruthful advertising matter, promotional literature, or testimonial;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being professionally, physically, or mentally incompetent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is professionally, physically, or mentally incompetent; or

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to cooperate with a lawful investigation conducted by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to cooperate with a lawful investigation conducted by the Board.

definition_quote.value: Practice as an environmental health specialist means, as a major component of employment, to apply academic principles, methods and procedures of the environmental, physical, biological, and health sciences to the inspections and investigations necessary to collect and analyze data and to make decisions necessary to secure compliance with federal, State, and local health and environmental laws and regulations specifically relating to control of the public health aspects of the environment
definition_quote.quote: "Practice as an environmental health specialist" means, as a major component of employment, to apply academic principles, methods and procedures of the environmental, physical, biological, and health sciences to the inspections and investigations necessary to collect and analyze data and to make decisions necessary to secure compliance with federal, State, and local health and environmental laws and regulations specifically relating to control of the public health aspects of the environment

value: compliance decisions under federal, state, and local health and environmental laws
methods_authorized.quote: to apply academic principles, methods and procedures of the environmental, physical, biological, and health sciences to the inspections and investigations necessary to collect and analyze data and to make decisions necessary to secure compliance with federal, State, and local health and environmental laws and regulations

credential_title.quote: the person may not use the title "environmental health specialist" or "licensed environmental health specialist" or the initials "E.H.S." or "L.E.H.S."

trainee_credential_title.quote: "Environmental health specialist–in–training" means an individual who meets the educational qualifications required under this title but has not yet completed the environmental health specialist–in–training program required under § 21–305 of this title.

trainee_permit_max_duration_years.quote: a person may not participate in an environmental health specialist–in–training program for more than 3 years, unless granted an extension by the Board

exempted_occupations.quote: This section does not apply to: (1) An environmental health specialist–in–training participating in an environmental health specialist–in–training program or an individual participating in an apprenticeship as provided for under § 21–305 of this subtitle; (2) A student participating in a field experience as part of an educational program; and (3) A qualified individual in any of the following job classifications:

value: The manufacture, preparation, handling, distribution, or sale of food and milk
scope_of_practice_areas.quote: specifically relating to control of the public health aspects of the environment including: (1) The manufacture, preparation, handling, distribution, or sale of food and milk; (2) Water supply and treatment; (3) Wastewater treatment and disposal; (4) Solid waste management and disposal; (5) Vector control; (6) Insect and rodent control; (7) Air quality; (8) Noise control; (9) Product safety; (10) Recreational sanitation; and (11) Institutional and residential sanitation.

natural_science_semester_hours_required.quote: A minimum of 30 semester credit hours or the equivalent quarter credit hours of chemical, physical, biological, and environmental sciences acceptable to the Board

field_experience_required_months.quote: Obtained 12 months of experience in an environmental health specialist–in–training program approved by the Board

supervision_required_for_trainees.quote: "Environmental health specialist–in–training program" means a program of training and experience under the supervision of a licensed environmental health specialist or other individual acceptable to the Board.

inactive_status_available.quote: The Board shall place a licensed environmental health specialist on inactive status for a period not to exceed 4 years if the licensed environmental health specialist: (i) Submits to the Board a written application for inactive status on a form the Board requires; and (ii) Pays to the Board the inactive status fee set by the Board.

inactive_status_max_duration_years.quote: The Board shall place a licensed environmental health specialist on inactive status for a period not to exceed 4 years

continuing_education_hours_per_period.quote: the licensee has acquired 20 hours of approved training in environmental health or other equivalent education as approved by the Board

reciprocity_experience_requirement_years.quote: Has performed at least 24 months of compensated work as an environmental health specialist or its equivalent in the other state.

code_of_ethics_required.quote: The Board shall adopt a code of ethics designed to protect the public's interest.

mandatory_peer_reporting_obligation.quote: If a licensed environmental health specialist knows of an action or condition that might be grounds for action under subsection (b) of this section, the licensed environmental health specialist shall report the action or condition to the Board.

unlicensed_practice_criminal_penalty_cla.quote: A person who violates any provision of § 21–301 of this title or § 21–401 of this subtitle is guilty of a misdemeanor and on conviction is subject to a fine not exceeding $5,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 2 years or both.
